name: touhou-music-player-desktop
description: Desktop app for the Touhou Music Player website
author: Touhou Music Player contributors

scripts.dist:win: tauri icon assets/icon.png && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.dist:linux: tauri icon assets/icon.png && tauri build --bundles appimage,deb
scripts.dist:mac: tauri icon assets/icon.png && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles dmg,app
